Name: Fire Whip
Components: V, S, M (a strip of burnt leather)
Description: You create a flaming whip that strikes one target within range as a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 3d8 fire damage and must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you may pull the target into any unoccupied space within the spell's range, where they land prone. Movement taken within the spell's range is not counted for falling damage.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each slot level above 2nd:
● The damage increases by 1d10.
● The spell's range increases by 5 feet.
● You may choose one additional target within range, who is affected by a separate fire whip. All creatures you target and move must land in spaces adjacent to one another; otherwise they are not pulled at all.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
